objective_pt: Convencer alguém de uma ideia: apresentar benefícios, antecipar objeções e fechar com uma pergunta ("What have we got to lose?").

teacher.goal_pt: Conversar sobre a última vez em que o aluno convenceu (ou foi convencido) e ver como ele argumenta.
prompts: When did you last convince someone to do something?
watchFor: Dizer "it's worth to try"; o certo é "it's worth trying".
Fechar frases com "no?" ("This is good, no?"); em inglês usamos question tags: "isn't it?".

exercises.prompt: Trust me, it's definitely worth trying.
accepted: Trust me, it's definitely worth trying.
Trust me, it is definitely worth trying.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "worth" usamos o verbo com -ing: "worth trying".
commonErrors.correction_en: Trust me, it's definitely worth trying.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which question tag is correct? "It's a great opportunity, ___?"
exercises.explanation_pt: Em inglês, a confirmação no fim usa o mesmo verbo da frase, negado: "It's..., isn't it?". O "no?" do português soa estranho.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Vale a pena tentar."
accepted: It's worth trying
It's worth a try
It's worth a shot
It's worth giving it a try
It's worth giving it a shot
It's worth it to try
It's definitely worth trying
It's worth trying it

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Worth" é seguido de -ing ou de um substantivo: "worth trying", "worth a try".
"Vale a pena" não é "worth the pain". Use só "worth it" ou "worth trying".
O inglês precisa do sujeito: "It's worth trying".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões de persuasão: benefit, in the long run, pay off, win-win, what's the catch, convince.
prompts: What's a habit that pays off in the long run?
When something looks too good, what do you ask?
watchFor: Dizer "convince you to" está certo, mas "persuade" é mais forte para levar à ação.
Dizer "in the long term" e "in the long run" misturados ("in the long time").

exercises.example_en: It's more expensive now, but it'll save you money in the long run.
All that hard work finally paid off.
It's a win-win situation: you save time and we save money.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "A longo prazo, isso vai valer a pena."
accepted: In the long run, it'll be worth it
In the long run, this will be worth it
In the long run, it will pay off
In the long run, this will pay off
In the long run, it's going to be worth it
In the long term, it'll be worth it
In the long term, this will pay off
It'll be worth it in the long run
It'll pay off in the long run
This will pay off in the long run

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A longo prazo" é "in the long run" ou "in the long term". "In a long time" significa "há muito tempo".
commonErrors.correction_en: In the long run, it'll be worth it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Worth" não é verbo: precisa do "be": "it will be worth it".
commonErrors.correction_en: In the long run, it'll be worth it.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a entonação persuasiva: pausa antes do ponto principal e ênfase nos benefícios.
prompts: Say "Just imagine..." and pause. How does it feel?
Which word would you stress in "It's completely free"?
watchFor: Falar rápido demais, sem pausa antes do ponto principal.
Pronunciar "worth" como "wort"; o "th" final é com a língua entre os dentes.

exercises.prompt: Just imagine... we could cut our costs in half.
accepted: Just imagine... we could cut our costs in half.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. Finish "worth" with your tongue between your teeth.
exercises.prompt: Believe me, it's worth every penny.
accepted: Believe me, it's worth every penny.
Believe me, it is worth every penny.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A palavra é "worth", terminando no som "th" (língua entre os dentes), não "word".
commonErrors.correction_en: Believe me, it's worth every penny.

exercises.instruction_pt: In a persuasive question tag, "It's a great deal, isn't it?", the voice usually...
options: goes down, because you expect a "yes"
goes up, because you really don't know
exercises.explanation_pt: Quando você espera concordância, a voz desce no "isn't it?". Subindo, soa como dúvida de verdade.

teacher.goal_pt: Reconhecer técnicas de persuasão e responder a objeções.
prompts: What's the best argument to convince your boss of something?
How do you answer "It's too expensive"?
watchFor: Responder objeções com "no, you are wrong"; treinar "I understand, but...".
Usar "advantage" e "benefit" com preposição errada ("advantage in").

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. Which technique does the speaker use?
exercises.listen: Not only will it save us money, but it'll also make the team happier. So what have we got to lose?
options: Two benefits and a question to close
exercises.explanation_pt: "Not only... but also..." soma dois benefícios, e "What have we got to lose?" fecha com uma pergunta retórica.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. Answer the objection: say you understand, but it pays off in the long run.
exercises.listen: I like the idea, but it's too expensive.
accepted: I understand, but it pays off in the long run
I understand, but it'll pay off in the long run
I see what you mean, but it'll pay off in the long run
I know it's expensive, but it'll pay off in the long run
I understand, but it's worth it in the long run
I understand, but it'll be worth it in the long run
I get that, but in the long run it'll pay off
I hear you, but it'll save us money in the long run
I understand, but it'll save money in the long run
That's true, but it pays off in the long run
Fair enough, but it'll pay off in the long run

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A longo prazo" é "in the long run", não "in a long time".
commonErrors.correction_en: I understand, but it'll pay off in the long run.
I understand, but it'll pay off in the long run.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. Convince your friend with "Wouldn't it be great if...?"
exercises.listen: I don't know if I want to go on the trip with you guys.
accepted: Wouldn't it be great if we all went together?
Wouldn't it be great if you came with us?
Wouldn't it be great if we went together?
Wouldn't it be great if you joined us?
Come on, wouldn't it be great if you came with us?
Wouldn't it be great to go together?
Wouldn't it be great if you came too?
Wouldn't it be great if we traveled together?
Wouldn't it be great if we travelled together?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "Wouldn't it be great if..." o verbo depois do "if" vai para o passado: "if you came".
commonErrors.correction_en: Wouldn't it be great if you came with us?

commonErrors.match: ^(will not|would) it be great if\b|^is not it great if\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para imaginar algo e convencer, use "Wouldn't it be great if...?", com o verbo depois do "if" no passado.
commonErrors.correction_en: Wouldn't it be great if you came with us?

teacher.goal_pt: Convencer o professor de uma ideia (uma viagem, uma mudança no trabalho, um produto), respondendo a objeções.
watchFor: Repetir o mesmo argumento; incentivar benefício, exemplo e pergunta de fechamento.
Ignorar a objeção; treinar "I understand, but..." e "That's exactly why...".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Não só é mais barato, mas também é mais rápido."
accepted: Not only is it cheaper, but it's also faster
Not only is it cheaper, it's also faster
Not only is it cheaper, but it is also quicker
It's not only cheaper, but also faster
It's not only cheaper but also quicker
It's not just cheaper, it's also faster
It's not only cheaper, it's also faster
Not only is it cheaper, but it's faster too

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Quando a frase começa com "Not only", invertemos: "Not only is it cheaper". Ou diga "It's not only cheaper...".
commonErrors.correction_en: Not only is it cheaper, but it's also faster.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Adjetivos curtos fazem o comparativo com "-er": "cheaper", "faster".
commonErrors.correction_en: Not only is it cheaper, but it's also faster.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Pense bem: o que a gente tem a perder?"
accepted: Think about it: what have we got to lose?
Think about it, what do we have to lose?
Think it over: what have we got to lose?
Think about it, what's there to lose?
Just think about it: what do we have to lose?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pense bem" não é "think well". Use "Think about it" ou "Think it over".
commonErrors.correction_en: Think about it: what have we got to lose?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta direta, precisa do auxiliar: "What do we have to lose?" ou "What have we got to lose?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What have we got to lose?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Perder" é "lose" (com som de "z"). "Loose" é "solto", com som de "s".
commonErrors.correction_en: What have we got to lose?

exercises.instruction_pt: Put the words in order to answer an objection.
accepted: I understand your concern but that's exactly why we need it

exercises.instruction_pt: Convince your manager to let the team work from home two days a week.
exercises.prompt_en: I'm not sure about this. Why should we let people work from home? Convince me.
guidelines_pt: Give two benefits: "Not only..., but also..."
Answer an objection: "I understand your concern, but..."
Close with a question: "Why don't we try it for a month? What have we got to lose?"

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar as expressões de persuasão e fechar o nível B2 com uma fala convincente.
prompts: Convince me to read your favorite book.
What's the biggest benefit of learning English?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eu te convenci, não convenci?"
accepted: I convinced you, didn't I?
I've convinced you, haven't I?
I persuaded you, didn't I?
I've persuaded you, haven't I?
I convinced you, right?
So I convinced you, didn't I?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para confirmar, o inglês usa question tag com o mesmo auxiliar: "I convinced you, didn't I?".

commonErrors.match: \bconvinced you (is not it|are not you|do not i)\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: O verbo está no passado simples, então o tag é "didn't I?".

accepted: it
taking
doing
trying

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "worth" usamos -ing ou "it": "worth taking", "worth it".
commonErrors.correction_en: This course is really worth taking.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which sentence is the most persuasive?
options: Just imagine how much time you'd save every week.
You should do it because I said so.
Maybe it's good, I don't know.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Just imagine..." faz a pessoa visualizar o benefício. As outras opções não convencem.

exercises.prompt: Give it a try. I promise you won't regret it.
accepted: Give it a try. I promise you won't regret it.
Give it a try. I promise you will not regret it.
